name: memory-consolidation
description: Memory audit pipeline — scanner-only since 2026-09-05 (memory-management plan §4/§6.2-2.1), execution handoff updated 2026-09-12: audits the two Nebula memory files, produces an entry-level report with the nine-metric header, and returns it to Nebula, whose MemoryEdit is now pure bookkeeping (queued notes) — the findings are applied at the next compaction by the memory-consolidation agent (memory-consolidator). No audit node writes memory directly (职权红线). Use when memory grows large, after major code changes, or via the weekly Schedule trigger (Sunday 21:30).
